resources.string: Enter a valid time range. At least one audio segment must remain.
Apply current speed and pitch settings to export

Times refer to the original audio. Apply multiple edits to join the remaining segments in their original order. Preview plays the entered source range. Speed affects preview only by default. The original file is unchanged; WAV files are usually larger than compressed audio. Each temporary WAV is limited to 512 MiB; at least 16 MiB of additional free space is required.
Pitch is preserved by default. Export can optionally apply the current speed and pitch settings.
Select a song storage folder first.
Could not copy to the song storage folder. Check folder access and available space.
Remove this song from the current queue? Song metadata, playlists, favorites and the original file will be kept.
